pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal and sub-rectangular dark brown regions. Edge gradients show moderate transition zones with micro-scale 'fraying' or serration rather than perfectly sharp geometric lines. Relative patch area is largest on the upper neck/shoulder region, reducing in size and increasing in spatial frequency towards the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white inter-patch pathways. Topological nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively consistent (estimated 15-25% of adjacent patch width) in the central flank, narrowing slightly at lower extremities. Network continuity is maintained throughout the visible field with no observed terminal breaks.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour visible along the superior cervical line. The mane manifests as a short, stiff 1D silhouette with consistent pixel-height spikes against the desaturated background.
